title: P1: verify the worker termination the record-unwritable path asserts (M0-T053 G5 finding 4)
objective: QUALIFYING EVIDENCE (AD-093 demonstrated security risk): M0-T053 G5 security review + M0-T036-ACTIVATION-CHECKLIST P1. claude_runner.py:1283-1298 (the record_unwritable except block) calls container.terminate_all() but DISCARDS its boolean, swallows exceptions, and never wait()/poll()s, yet the raised RunnerError('child_record_unwritable') states the worker WAS terminated. On the degraded-taskkill path terminate_process_tree can legitimately return False; compound failure (degraded containment + failed journal write + failed kill) = a LIVE UNRECORDED orphan with an empty record + a traceback exit, after which the next start reads SAFE_CHECKPOINT and DOUBLE-LAUNCHES (squarely D-010-R347). SCOPE (smallest durable set): capture terminate_all()'s boolean, add a bounded process.wait(), and raise a DISTINCT reason code (not the generic child_record_unwritable) when the child is verifiably STILL ALIVE after the kill attempt, so the fail-closed refusal is honest about whether an orphan survives. Correct nothing else (no redesign; supervisor-freeze). REQUIRED TESTS: kill-succeeds path still raises child_record_unwritable; kill-returns-False / child-still-alive path raises the DISTINCT code; bounded wait does not hang; full supervisor suite re-establishes the M0-T039 freeze baseline (>=1165, 0 failures) plus the new tests.
business_reason: P1 is a required pre-M0-T056 correction (M0-T036-ACTIVATION-CHECKLIST): it closes the double-launch residual where an unverified termination assertion lets the next start launch a second worker over a live orphan (R347). Non-blocking for M0-T053 acceptance (already accepted); blocking before live actuation.
forbidden_paths: tools/agent_supervisor/** modules not named in allowed_paths (smallest durable set only; wider need = STOP-and-report)
Any redesign or speculative supervisor feature (supervisor-freeze; defect-only)
acceptance_scenarios: P1-SC1 kill-succeeds: record_launched_child raises; terminate_all() returns True (or the child is confirmed reaped by a bounded wait) -> RunnerError('child_record_unwritable') as before, worker gone.

P1-SC2 kill-unverified: terminate_all() returns False or the bounded process.wait() times out with the child still alive -> a DISTINCT reason code (e.g. child_record_unwritable_orphan_live) is raised, naming that a live orphan may survive, so the operator/next-start is not told the worker was terminated when it was not.
P1-SC3 bounded wait does not hang: the wait has a finite timeout and never blocks the unit indefinitely.
P1-SC4 freeze baseline: full supervisor suite re-establishes the M0-T039 baseline (>=1165 passed, 0 failures) plus the new P1 tests; non-vacuity shown (reverting the guard fails a test).
risks: File overlap: P2 (M0-T059) also edits claude_runner.py (the _settle_worker_record caller of clear_child_record); build P1 FIRST, then P2 branches off P1's claude_runner.py. Never run P1/P2 producers in parallel.
Supervisor-freeze: change the tree hash and re-establish the M0-T039 suite baseline under G0/G2/G3/G5.
Windows-Job-Object-only host (P8); degraded-taskkill path is the one this fix hardens.
